title: English Practice Quiz 0284
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: They finished ___ the room.
questions.explanation: Finish is followed by a gerund.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Use the present simple for general facts.

questions.question: Please close ___ door.
questions.explanation: The refers to a specific door known to the speaker and listener.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use there are with plural nouns.

questions.question: You have completed a task. You say:
questions.explanation: The task is complete is a clear status update.

questions.question: I have ___ my keys.
questions.explanation: Lost is the past participle of lose.

questions.question: There isn't ___ milk left.
questions.explanation: Milk is uncountable, so use much in a negative sentence.

questions.question: I ___ a new notebook yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday signals the past simple. The past form of buy is bought.

questions.question: By next June, he ___ the course.
questions.explanation: The future perfect describes an action completed before a future time.
